installation: Official registry/source copied with content identity checked; dependency installed separately.
localAdaptations: Semantic h2 and permanent HTML fallback; canvas enhancement is decorative
Lazy import only in viewport on fine pointer desktop >=768px without reduced motion in a visible tab
Resolve actual first --font-acid family and await document.fonts.load + fonts.ready before loading renderer
Use loaded Acid Bold 700 rather than upstream unavailable weight800
Root span replaces div so markup remains valid inside h2
First-frame callback preserves visible HTML until a raster is successfully drawn
Pause RAF before text readiness and when offscreen, tab-hidden or reduced motion
Dispose entire renderer on wrapper disable/unmount and retain semantic fallback on initialization/context/render failure
Reject unavailable Canvas2D rasterization before onReady so a blank texture cannot hide the HTML title
touchPolicy: HTML fallback, no canvas/pointer capture on coarse/mobile; scroll gestures stay native
performance: Official ambient shader animates while visible; texture rasterization occurs on font/size/text/color changes, not every frame. DPR capped at2. No RAF offscreen, hidden tab or reduced motion.
verificationLimit: Browser prototype and responsive matrix verified in Chrome headless with SwiftShader; DOM tests do not verify visual quality, and this does not measure physical GPU performance.
